Trying to find some people who are chill to game with, can be hard in Ark. Figured why not try Voat. Oh and I've never posted my server to that other website either.

Anyways, we run 3xGathering 6xTaming 4xExperience, Level 240 Wild Dinosaurs, a unique map 'The Center', and some other popular mods.

[PT][Lv240WildDinos][3XGather7XTaming][Castles&More]

192.99.21.89:27042

PvP server, currently not very populated, only a few players. Fresh server. So far those who are playing aren't PVP oriented, we just find playing on PVE servers to be boring.

[Steam Workshop link to the map we use.](http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=614734500) If you want to play, subscribe to the map now, it'll initiate the download for it. ( 1.4gb ) Much easier to download it that way than by joining the server. If you don't have auto updates enabled on Steam, mods won't actively download. Manual installation is tedious. Try turning it on temporarily to download all the mod data.

We're also using a item stacking mod, so mostly all items now have increased stack sizes, stone for instance goes up to 1000 and has a slightly reduced weight. We have worked around the jerky glitch caused by the stacking mod by using another mod that creates Jerky. Although I can't get around the Slingshot glitch, making it unusable! That being said I think the stacking mod is worth it, and narq arrows aren't too hard to get.

There's the Advanced Architecture mod as well, commonly called "Castles", and "Advance Ark 8.1" which adds a bunch of random stuff. ( It fixes the Jerky problem. )

Big Rafts, adds improved structure capacity on rafts and a "Dino Barge" which is a much larger boat made of metal and cementing paste etc.

Full list of mods here http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=605630505

For whatever it's worth, I played a lot on a Official server when I first started with Ark, grew tired of hackers and no real server support. Joined a solid unofficial server with low multipliers, similar to Official but a bit spruced up -- no mods. Spent a lot of time there, eventually the server shut down without notice. Bummed me out. Since then I've jumped between a few servers, some close down, some had admin abuse, I just got tired of dealing with all the uncertainties when playing a game with such a high level of time investment. So I looked into hosting my own server, and have played around with various mods over the past few months. I feel the server I'm running now is a unique experience from Vanilla Ark. It's not as grindy, but there's still progression and what I find to be an enjoyable play style. If you've played Ark a lot, it's something different, if you're new to Ark, it's still easy to pick up and run with.
